tools.name: search_clubs
tools.description: Find youth sports clubs in the Hat Trick Local directory by name, town, state or distance (the listings today are soccer clubs). Use it whenever a person names a club, even vaguely or misspelled: when no listing matches every word, the answer lists candidates with similar names. Each result has the

tools.name: get_club
tools.description: One club's full listing: contacts, programs, locations, and its current season records (registration windows, fees and tryouts, each with its source link and how it was verified), plus its club website, shop link and action links when it has them.

tools.name: list_registration_windows
tools.description: Registration windows on record across clubs, for questions like 'which clubs in Ohio have registration open now' or 'what opens in January'. Filter by state, town, club name words, status and dates. Each window has its opening and closing dates, season, source link and verification.

tools.name: search_stores
tools.description: Find local sports stores (soccer stores today) by name, chain, town, state or distance, with address, phone, brands and whether they outfit teams. Each result has the store's org_key for get_store and the link tools.

tools.name: get_store
tools.description: One store's full listing: address, phone, hours where listed, brands, whether it outfits teams, and its online ordering and action links when it has them.

tools.name: create_claim_link
tools.description: A link to hand a person who runs a club or store, so they can claim its free listing. Opening it changes nothing: the person fills in and sends the claim on the page. If the listing is already claimed, the person can still send a claim and Hat Trick Local reviews it. Never open the link to submit fo

tools.name: create_correction_link
tools.description: A link to hand a person who found something wrong in a listing. It opens the listing with the correction form open (field preselects what is wrong); the person writes and sends it, and Hat Trick Local reviews it before anything changes. Never submit for the person.

tools.name: create_shop_link
tools.description: A link to where a club or store sells online through Hat Trick Local (a club's team store or a store's online ordering). Many listings do not sell online; the answer then says so and gives the listing's page. The person chooses and pays there; never order or pay for them.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_claim_link, create_correction_link · Private data: get_club, list_registration_windows · Public sink: create_claim_link, create_correction_link.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: create_claim_link, create_correction_link · Private data: get_club, list_registration_windows · Public sink: create_claim_link, create_correction_link

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
